title: The Enchanted Market at The Briars
summary: Vibrant family-friendly market in the scenic Briars nature reserve at Mount Martha. Showcases homemade and homegrown goods, regional produce and handcrafted items from passionate stallholders. Set in a wildlife reserve with walking trails, boardwalks and native wildlife.
